description: Acquires the pinned current FDIC BankFind active-institution and location indexes and normalizes institution, office, address, point, service-type, status, and temporal evidence.
retry: Retry transient query failures with capped exponential backoff; fail after four attempts.
checkpoint: Pin institution and location index names and creation timestamps before normalization; any total or index change invalidates the run.
idempotency: FDIC certificate and unique location numbers determine stable source-record and entity-candidate IDs; index metadata identifies the source snapshot.
cancellation: Abort the active request, leave all unpublished artifacts run-scoped, and do not change current.json before complete quality-gated publication.
retention_profile: Retain immutable public source snapshots and normalized releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
